title: Paper-explicit core reactions are deleted pre-freeze when their enzyme has no external identity, while the same situation elsewhere ships an Unknown placeholder
evidence: final_payload.quarantined_locked_reactions reason protein_missing_external_identity: idx 5 MenD isochorismate -> SEPHCHC (gold_v2 PMC12421875 R2; chain breaks after isochorismate); idx 121 HS41.20 dehydratase and both HS41.17 mutase steps (the two furanose products named in the pathway title are absent); idx 68 LpxL/LpxM. Same run family exports 88 Unknown-only complexes (a4/unknown_complexes.json), e.g. idx 9 MenI/MenA.
proposed_fix: Apply one rule: a paper-explicit reaction whose enzyme fails identity keeps the reaction with a placeholder enzyme (as section 13 already licenses) and is marked review_required, instead of being removed.
options: (a) Keep the reaction, enzyme as Unknown placeholder (consistent with the section 13 standing position). Cost: more placeholder rows; small change at the quarantine admission rule; no loss of gold recall (idx 5 -> 9/9).
(b) Keep the reaction with no enzyme, flagged review_required. Cost: enzyme-less reactions in PWML; PathWhiz accepts them (idx 116 R2, 148 R5 already do).
(c) Status quo. Cost: gold-scored recall loss (idx 5 8/9) and pathways whose named end products vanish (idx 121).

title: Wrong enzyme assignments in the payload
evidence: 134: TMLD and BBD on both reaction 1 and 4 ('Reactions 1 and 4 are catalyzed by ... TMLD and ... BBD', i.e. respectively) and mouse-only Tha1 in the human pathway ('a mouse protein absent in humans'); 7: Chl synthase step drawn with CHLI (WP3018: CHLG AT3G51820), FLU ('a negative regulator of ALA synthesis') as GluTR enzyme; 126: BBO/BSE/BSα/CAD1 scattered onto BR, BPBT and BS steps; 120: HSD17B1 ('undetectable in the testis ... cannot compensate'); 129: RibBA on RibD step; 128: CoaX as pantethine transporter, CoaA missing; 78/58: EntE step and EntF/EntD complexes = [EntB,EntD,EntF,EntE]; 116: 'ceramide synthase' grounded to TLCD3B (UniProt Q71RH2), not CERS1-6.
proposed_fix: Add a deterministic enzyme-step consistency check before freeze: the enzyme's own evidence sentence must name the reaction's substrate or product (or the 'respectively' order), and organism-restricted genes are checked against the run organism. Flag, do not auto-assign.
options: (a) Pre-freeze check that drops an enzyme whose evidence does not bind it to the step (keeps the reaction). Cost: some true multi-enzyme statements lose an enzyme; changes extraction-side code (rule 6, PO).
(b) Same check, but flag review_required only. Cost: wrong enzymes still exported, but labelled.
(c) Prompt-level fix for 'respectively' and regulator-vs-catalyst wording. Cost: Stage-1 nondeterminism; needs re-run evidence.

title: Reactions with no stated compartment are drawn in the first biological state, inventing locations
evidence: ir.py resolve_state (~line 1836-1841) returns default_bs_key for any null state. 138: all 8 tubercidin steps in 'extracellular' although 'TubI is responsible for transporting TBN out of the cell once synthesized'; 134: SHMT1, TMABADH and BBD steps in the mitochondrion although 'carnitine biosynthesis occurs initially in the mitochondria and subsequently in the cytosol' (Reactome R-HSA-71262 confirms cytosolic ALDH9A1/BBOX1/SHMT1); 116: SphK, SMase, ceramidase in ER (paper gives none, GSL hydrolysis 'principally in the lysosome'); 144: AmOMT2 in ER; 128: spontaneous extracellular cysteinopantetheine formation in cytoplasm. Counts: a1/null_state_default.json.
proposed_fix: Exporter: map a null state to an organism-level 'cell' state with no subcellular location (create one if absent), never to an arbitrary named compartment. Contract section 1 forbids inventing locations; section 5 forbids exporter reinterpretation.
options: (a) Neutral organism-level state. Cost: small IR change; PWML compartments get a generic 'cell' box.
(b) Move the default upstream of freeze so final_payload is honest. Cost: touches pipeline output schema.

title: Exporter quarantines a correct reaction and keeps a wrong shortcut (idx 116 sphinganine -> dihydroceramide)
evidence: base/116/outputs__quarantine_report.json stage pre_export_strict_quarantine, pointer /processes/reactions/4, reason reaction_enzyme_must_be_protein_complex: the enzyme is a bare protein with no Stage-6 wrapper. The PWML keeps R2 sphinganine -> ceramide (enzyme-less, skips dihydroceramide) and R5 dihydroceramide -> ceramide whose substrate now has no producer. Paper: 'The desaturation of these dihydroceramides ... by dihydroceramide Δ4-desaturase 1 produces ceramide'. a1/per_pathway.json: missing_in_pwml for 116.
proposed_fix: Ensure Stage 6 creates the protein-complex wrapper for every surviving protein catalyst before freeze (so the exporter has nothing to drop), and make the pre-export quarantine fail loudly rather than silently remove a frozen reaction. Separately (A): R2 is a conflated step; the identity Q71RH2 (TLCD3B) is wrong.
options: (a) Wrapper fix upstream of freeze only. Cost: small; reaction returns with TLCD3B identity, which is itself wrong (S1) unless identity is also withheld to placeholder.
(b) Wrapper fix + withhold the name-matched identity (placeholder). Cost: one more Unknown complex.
(c) Leave as is. Cost: exported de novo chain is biochemically wrong.

title: Collapsed or conflated steps with wrong products
evidence: 68: LpxA product written as the post-LpxC glucosamine; LpxD/LpxH/LpxB/LpxK collapsed into one 'LpxB' step; LpxC/LpxD/LpxH/LpxK extracted as X -> X and quarantined (coarse_grained_same_entity_transformation) -> 3/8 pinned_v1 expected enzymes present as catalysts. 116: sphinganine -> ceramide. 138: compound 3 -> 5 skips PurA/PurB ('the missing two enzymes, adenylosuccinate synthetase (PurA), and adenylosuccinate lyase (PurB)'). 19: DmaW+EasF as one step. 148: CYP83B1 + GSH conjugation collapsed. 114: DltA adenylation without D-alanyl-AMP; DltC loading extracted as D-Ala -> D-Ala and quarantined.
proposed_fix: When the coarse-grained X -> X detector fires, route the enzyme sentence to a targeted re-extraction for the intermediate (the paper usually names it) instead of only quarantining.
options: (a) Targeted re-extraction of the step on coarse-grained hits. Cost: one bounded LLM call per hit; extraction change.
(b) Keep the collapsed reaction but flag review_required with the skipped enzymes listed. Cost: still a wrong product in PWML.
(c) Status quo (quarantine). Cost: idx 68 loses 6 of 9 steps.

title: Invented or non-evidence reactions survive to export
evidence: 126 R2 benzaldehyde -> salicylic acid by BBO (paper: BBO hydroxylates benzyl benzoate to benzyl salicylate); R2-R4 evidence is the literal pathway name. 144 R5 'liquiritigenin + naringenin -> isoflavone backbone' (rag_literature; evidence is the article metadata header). 7 R21 Pchlide -> singlet oxygen with GluTR/FC1 as activators. 78 R6 porcine LDH coupled assay (gold_v2 off_pathway O2; contract: no assay reporters). 128 R9 a methods-section chemical preparation. 135 R9 MgCl2 as substrate.
proposed_fix: Pre-freeze evidence gate: reject a reaction whose evidence string does not contain at least one of its participants (catches 126, 144) and tag methods/assay sentences (catches 78, 128, 135).
options: (a) Hard gate (drop). Cost: may drop a few true reactions with paraphrased evidence; 'smaller supported pathway preferable' supports it.
(b) Soft gate (review_required). Cost: invented content still drawn.

title: Inhibitor/activator modifiers drawn as enzymes; idx 9 inhibitor is itself invented
evidence: B: ir.py line 2178 (and validator ~3102) add modifiers with role activator/inhibitor to enzyme_sources, so they become reaction-enzymes. A: idx 9 R5 OSB-CoA -> DHNA-CoA carries 'MenD complex' role inhibitor; the paper only says 'the allosteric inhibition of MenD by DHNA' (gold_v2 excluded_statements: 'DHNA allosterically inhibits MenD', regulation), already present as interaction I0. So the PWML shows MenD catalysing the MenB step. 7: GUN4 (activator) drawn as Mg-chelatase enzyme; GluTR/FC1 drawn as enzymes of the invented singlet-oxygen reaction. a2/modifiers_as_enzymes.json.
proposed_fix: B: stop mapping activator/inhibitor to reaction-enzymes; emit them as PWML interactions (or drop with a report issue). A: idx 9 modifier is an extraction error.
options: (a) Emit as interaction elements. Cost: needs a PWML interaction mapping for reaction-level modifiers.
(b) Drop with warning. Cost: real activators (GUN4) disappear from the drawing.

title: Duplicate reactions and duplicated chains in synonymous states
evidence: Payload already contains them; exporter renders faithfully. 9: R10-R18 repeat R0-R8 ('L. lactis KF147 state' = cell vs 'Lactococcus lactis intracellular state'); 5: chain in 3 states + RAG copy (9 dups); 134: 10 reactions for 4 steps; 120: androstenedione -> testosterone 5 times; 12: one glucosylation 4 times; 7: 5 dups; 10/150: H+ entry 3x. Counts: a2/duplicate_reactions.json; this assessor's per_pathway.json duplicates.
proposed_fix: Pre-freeze dedup on (canonical inputs, outputs, resolved subcellular location) merging enzyme lists and evidence; treat 'cell'/'intracellular'/'cytoplasm' of a bacterium as one location.
options: (a) Merge on resolved location with a synonym table for prokaryotic 'cell/intracellular/cytoplasm'. Cost: a location-equivalence decision the PO owns.
(b) Merge only exact same-state duplicates. Cost: leaves the 9/5/134 chain duplication.

title: Unknown placeholder enzymes (88 of 162 complexes), labelled Arabidopsis thaliana in every organism, including canonical human enzymes
evidence: a4/unknown_complexes.json: 88/162 payload complexes are Unknown-only; the Unknown protein row carries species 'Arabidopsis thaliana' in 20/26 payloads (human, mouse, bacterial). idx 134: all six human enzymes (TMLHE, SHMT1, SHMT2, ALDH9A1, BBOX1 are reviewed UniProt entries) failed as species_mismatch. idx 5 vs idx 9 (same paper): Men proteins Unknown vs grounded (Q9CHJ9..).
proposed_fix: Section 13 makes placeholder export a standing disagreement: do not 'fix' the policy. Escalate two narrower points: the species label on the sentinel, and species_mismatch failures for human enzymes in a human pathway.
options: (a) Keep sentinel but write the run organism (or no species) on the placeholder row in PWML. Cost: deviates from the PathBank Unknown record (id 9659).
(b) Investigate the species_mismatch path for human/mouse runs only. Cost: identity-ladder work (mapping/, biology track).
(c) No change (section 13). Cost: a human pathway shows plant-species proteins.

title: Reversibility and stoichiometry cannot be represented: the payload schema has neither field
evidence: No key matching revers*/direction* in any of 196 payload reactions (scripts/a4_rev.py); inputs/outputs are bare names. 8 reactions in 5 pathways cite reversibility (9 R0/R9/R10, 5 R0, 129 R6, 142 R1 '⇌', 68 R0 'reversible acylation'); all 196 written direction Right (a1/per_pathway.json). Stoichiometry always 1: 142 '2.0 Pyruvate' -> 1; 14 'NADPH or NADH' encoded as both co-substrates. The exporter is faithful to the payload, so this is A (schema), not B. gold_v2 marks MenF and EntC reversible=true.
proposed_fix: Add optional reversible and per-participant stoichiometry fields to the Stage-1 schema and carry them through freeze; exporter writes direction from them.
options: (a) Add both fields (default unknown, never inferred). Cost: schema + prompt + canonical-hash allowlist change.
(b) Reversibility only. Cost: stoichiometry stays 1.
(c) Status quo. Cost: section 2 'correct directionality and reversibility, correct stoichiometry' unmet.

title: Wrong direction / wrong co-substrate identities
evidence: 142 IlvE written 2-OG + Val -> KIV + Glu (catabolic) in a biosynthesis pathway (paper row is ⇌). 5 MenA co-substrate grounded to DMAPP (C5) where the paper says 'prenyl diphosphate' (idx 9 kept it). 14 HMGR with NADPH + NADH both consumed.
proposed_fix: Orientation check against the requested pathway's net direction when the source marks a reaction reversible; never ground a generic class name ('prenyl diphosphate') to a specific compound.
options: (a) Deterministic orientation rule for ⇌ rows. Cost: needs reversibility field (F10).
(b) Flag only. Cost: backwards step stays drawn.

title: Transports with lost compartments, wrong cargo or wrong/missing transporter
evidence: 78 enterobactin secretion and 138 TBN export written cell -> cell with no transporter (paper: TolC-dependent; TubI MFS). 134 cargo TMABA where paper says 'postulated mitochondrial TML/HTML antiporter' (Reactome: HTMLYS translocates). 128 CoaX (a kinase) as pantethine transporter; PanU/EcfA1/EcfA2 quarantined so the ECF complex is EcfT only.
proposed_fix: Transport admission: from_state != to_state required; transporter entity must be named in the transport's own evidence sentence.
options: (a) Gate pre-freeze. Cost: transports with no named transporter become transporter-less (honest).
